edition.name: Migne, Patrologia Latina 5 (1844), via Latin Wikisource
edition.witness_note: Single locked witness in repo; second witness not yet locked.

source_text: Incolae coelorum futuri cum Deo Christo Tenente principium, vidente cuncta de coelo. Simplicitas, bonitas, habitet in corpore vestro. Irasci nolite sine causa fratri devoto: Recipietis enim quidquid feceritis ab illo. Hoc placuit Christo, resurgere mortuos, imo, Cum suis corporibus, et quos ignis ussit in aevo, Sex millibus annis completis mundo finito. Vertitur interea coelum tenore mutato: Comburuntur enim impii tunc igne divino. Ira Dei summi ardet creatura gemendo. Digniores, stemmate et generati praeclaro, Nobilesque viri sub Antichristo devicto: Ex praecepto Dei rursum viventes in aevo, Mille quidem annis ut serviant sanctis et Alto, Sub jugo servili, ut portent victualia collo; Ut iterum autem judicentur regno finito. Nullificantes Deum, completo millesimo anno, Ab igne peribunt, cum montibus ipsi loquendo. In bustis et tumulis omnis caro redditur acto, Demerguntur inferno, trahunt poenas in aevo. Ostenduntur illis, et legunt gesta de coelo Memoria prisca debito et merita digno. Merces in perpetuo secundum facta tyranno. Omnia non possum comprehendere parvo libello. Curiositas docti inveniet nomen in isto.
pass_a_gloss: Inhabitants of future heavens with God Christ holding the beginning, seeing all things from heaven. Simplicity, goodness, let it dwell in your body. Do not be angry without cause with a devoted brother: for you will receive whatever you do from him. This pleased Christ, to resurrect the dead, indeed, with their bodies, and those whom fire has burned in the age, when six thousand years are completed and the world is finished. Meanwhile, heaven is turned with a changed tenor: for the wicked are burned then by divine fire. The creature groans, burning with the anger of highest God. More worthy, of noble lineage and born of famous stock, and noble men, with Antichrist defeated: living again by the command of God in the age, for a thousand years, so that they may serve the saints and the Highest, under a servile yoke, so that they may carry provisions on their neck; so that they may be judged again when the kingdom is finished. Those who nullify God, when the thousandth year is completed, will perish from fire, speaking with the mountains themselves. All flesh is returned, having been done, in the tombs and graves, they are submerged in hell, they drag punishments in the age. Their deeds are shown to them, and they read the deeds from heaven, from ancient memory, due debt and worthy merits. Reward in perpetuity according to deeds to the tyrant. I am not able to comprehend all things in a small book. The curiosity of the learned will find a name in this.

pass_b_english: Future inhabitants of heaven, with God Christ holding the beginning, seeing all from heaven: let simplicity and goodness dwell in your body. Do not be angry without cause with a devoted brother, for you will receive back whatever you have done to him. This pleased Christ: to resurrect the dead, indeed with their bodies, and those whom fire has burned in the age, when six thousand years are completed and the world ends. Meanwhile heaven is turned with a changed tenor, for the wicked are burned then by divine fire. Creation groans, burning with the anger of the highest God. The more worthy, of noble lineage and born of famous stock, and noble men, with Antichrist defeated, live again by the command of God in the age for a thousand years, so that they may serve the saints and the Highest under a servile yoke, so that they may carry provisions on their necks, so that they may be judged again when the kingdom ends. Those who nullify God, when the thousandth year is completed, will perish by fire, speaking with the mountains themselves. All flesh is returned to the deed in tombs and graves; they are submerged in hell, dragging punishments through the age. Their deeds are shown to them, and they read the deeds from heaven, from ancient memory, the due debt and worthy merits. Reward in perpetuity according to deeds for the tyrant. I cannot comprehend all things in a small book. The curiosity of the learned will find a name in this.
